frames.title: Initial/ready/selected
frames.annotation: Selection and actual chart/numeric values co-present; replay controls only for declared mode. No demo prices; valid selection or retained run; IF-REC-001/005

frames.title: Loading or obsolete range/selection
frames.annotation: Pending request identified in selection region; retain old labelled plot/values or explicit unavailable at new boundary. Do not relabel old arrays; discard obsolete callback; IF-REC-001

frames.title: Empty/no match/unavailable/warm-up/actual coverage end
frames.annotation: Reason replaces absent value, not whole workspace; actual end distinct from paging. Change query/range; positions not liquidated at end; IF-REC-001/005

frames.title: Partial/stale/offline/known closure
frames.annotation: Feed/coverage limitation persists with readable history; no invented movement. Qualified history usable, gap policy unchanged; IF-REC-012

frames.title: Replay evaluating/blocked or slow panel
frames.annotation: Cursor/reason and coherent prefix remain primary; panel values unavailable within same boundary if not yet ready. No new decision beyond unfinished event; open original-event view; IF-REC-005/010

frames.title: Preview/invalid or locked annotation
frames.annotation: Preview/target/validation distinct from committed plot; object collection remains accessible. Correct/cancel/unlock permitted target; IF-REC-002/003

frames.title: Save failed/unknown; request error
frames.annotation: Status region exposes working versus retained state and safe next action without replacing coherent financial content. Reconcile/retain, not rerun trade/edit; IF-REC-013

frames.title: Destructive review or restricted writer
frames.annotation: Review routes to UIS-VIEW-007; restricted mutations unavailable with reason, inspection retained. Cancel unchanged; no silent takeover; IF-REC-006/013

frames.title: Ready/selected
frames.annotation: Named scope, committed values and draft visible. Apply/cancel separate; IF-REC-002/007

frames.title: Loading/calculating/preview
frames.annotation: Preview/estimate explicitly pending or temporary; prior valid values remain identified. Await matching result or cancel; IF-REC-002/007

frames.title: Missing/warm-up/unknown spec or FX
frames.annotation: Affected estimate unavailable, required fact/reason near inputs. No invented zero/contract/rate; resolve prerequisite; IF-REC-007/010

frames.title: Invalid parameter/quantity/risk
frames.annotation: Field and constraint identified; no application to committed state. Correct/cancel; IF-REC-002/007

frames.title: Basis/target changed or superseded estimate
frames.annotation: Old estimate no longer actionable; review scope and current values before apply. Retain draft visibly as draft; re-decide, do not revalue prior results; IF-REC-007

frames.title: Offline/provider metadata unavailable
frames.annotation: Local retained settings available; remote metadata limitation separate. Valid local configuration remains; unknown required values block affected action; IF-REC-007/012

frames.title: Applied working state; save failed/unknown
frames.annotation: Commit result distinct from unsaved/unknown checkpoint; no duplicate apply to repair save. IF-REC-013; retain current valid settings

frames.title: Restricted/absent target
frames.annotation: Editing unavailable with reason; valid settings inspectable. Fresh valid authority/target needed; cancel/return; IF-REC-002/013

frames.title: Ready/selected retained work
frames.annotation: Collection and selected details/save scope visible. Choose restore/resume/arrangement/backup distinctly; IF-REC-004/013/014

frames.title: Initial/empty
frames.annotation: No layouts/runs/checkpoint stated; create supported analysis available. No fabricated saved state; IF-REC-004/013

frames.title: Loading/copying/validating/saving
frames.annotation: Identify selected candidate/phase, preserve old retained generation and current work. Cancel preparation where supported or await; IF-REC-013/014

frames.title: Newer unsaved state/older acknowledgement
frames.annotation: Current working changes and retained version distinguished; backup names included retained snapshot. Retry valid retention or explicit chosen checkpoint, no “all saved” claim; IF-REC-013/014

frames.title: Unknown save/replacement/output publication
frames.annotation: Show reconciliation responsibility and operation scope; incompatible repeated writes unavailable. Inspect authoritative generation/artifact before retry; IF-REC-013/014

frames.title: Known storage/read failure or missing/corrupt required inputs
frames.annotation: Affected restore/resume/backup unavailable with reason; old valid checkpoint/other work preserved. Correct storage/use coherent backup; never latest-data substitution; IF-REC-013/014

frames.title: Invalid/unsafe backup or incompatible scope
frames.annotation: Validation reasons replace candidate readiness; no partial activation. Reject candidate/select valid backup; IF-REC-014

frames.title: Offline/restricted/confirmation needed
frames.annotation: Offline local work remains available; second-writer mutations unavailable; destructive review routes to UIS-VIEW-007. Permitted inspection, fresh authority or cancel; IF-REC-004/013/014

frames.title: Ready/draft/selected pending instruction or position
frames.annotation: Run, actual terms/target and action family explicit. Submit/modify/cancel/close distinctly; IF-REC-008/009

frames.title: No active run/positions/results or now-closed target
frames.annotation: Explain missing context or empty collection; retain historical closed-position detail if selected. Start/resume run, inspect existing records; no fictitious trade/result; IF-REC-008/011

frames.title: Sizing/loading/submitting/event evaluation
frames.annotation: Pending estimate/request/evaluation and scope visible; old valid terms remain identified. No new decision past unfinished event; reconcile same intent; IF-REC-008/009

frames.title: Accepted/effective/triggered/filled/cancelled
frames.annotation: Distinct instruction/execution fact plus whole quantity/protection/fee/USD result. Acceptance/trigger is not fill or saved acknowledgement; IF-REC-008/011

frames.title: Invalid/rejected/over-close/target conflict
frames.annotation: Specific field/remainder/target reason near request; prior valid pending order intact. Correct/review current target; IF-REC-008/009

frames.title: Blocked evidence/FX/spec/gap
frames.annotation: Original reason/event and coherent prefix co-present; no partial new effect. Open UIS-VIEW-005; dismiss does not resolve; IF-REC-010

frames.title: Stale draft/settings or uncertain command/save response
frames.annotation: Superseded estimate/target nonactionable; accepted working effect separate from retained status. Re-read/reconcile same occurrence; no duplicate submit; IF-REC-008/009/013

frames.title: Offline/restricted
frames.annotation: Retained-run inspection continues if required inputs local; data outage not permission for guessed fill; writer-denied mutations unavailable. Qualified retained reads, authority/prerequisite recovery; IF-REC-010/013

frames.title: Explained block
frames.annotation: Original reason/event and last coherent prefix primary. Resolve required fact or remain paused; IF-REC-010

frames.title: Evidence loading/recovery partial
frames.annotation: Requested prerequisite/known phase visible without fill. Qualified retry/cancel inspection; block persists; IF-REC-010/012

frames.title: Missing/invalid/inapplicable prerequisite
frames.annotation: Needed fact and specific rejection/absence reason remain. No guessed price/FX/closure; correct evidence or later resume; IF-REC-010

frames.title: Compatible resolution being applied
frames.annotation: Original event/context and pending whole effect identified. No intervening new decision or duplicate resolution; IF-REC-010

frames.title: Known resolved or outcome unknown
frames.annotation: Known whole effect replaces active block; unknown publication requires reconciliation before further mutation. Preserve original event/recorded outcome; no automatic play; IF-REC-010/013

frames.title: Incompatible retained-basis change
frames.annotation: Explain why new catalog/spec evidence cannot silently alter committed history. Stay blocked or deliberate restart with confirmation; IF-REC-010/006

frames.title: Offline/retryable read failure
frames.annotation: Retained evidence inspectable, missing network fact unavailable. Qualified retry when possible; no provider deadline; IF-REC-010/012

frames.title: Stale event/epoch, no current block or restricted
frames.annotation: Old explanation identified as historical/nonactionable; mutation denied or return to current state. Discard stale completion, fresh current context needed; IF-REC-010/013

frames.title: Receiving/qualified ready
frames.annotation: Actual receipt/feed condition and current qualified coverage visible. Current catalog distinct from saved-run basis; IF-REC-012

frames.title: Discovering/catching up/partial/provisional
frames.annotation: Phase, requested span, qualified subset and unresolved remainder visible. Retain published history; partial not complete/final; IF-REC-012

frames.title: No recent receipt/unknown freshness/proven closure
frames.annotation: Distinct reasoned conditions; known closure only from evidence. No fabricated movement or closure inference; IF-REC-012

frames.title: Empty/invalid/conflicting response or coverage
frames.annotation: Span/reason explains absence/conflict; old qualified catalog remains. Retry qualified read/re-decide overlap; not silent last-writer-wins; IF-REC-012

frames.title: Stale/offline/disconnected/rate-limited
frames.annotation: Limitation and last known usable coverage remain; no invented recovery deadline. Read local history, qualified bounded reconnect/retry; IF-REC-012

frames.title: Access denied/unverified provider capability
frames.annotation: Required live limitation explicit, no false ready or demo substitution. Protected setup/integration evidence required; historical mode usable; IF-REC-012

frames.title: Local publication unknown/storage failure/display lag
frames.annotation: Distinguish receipt, visible display and retained catalog outcome. Inspect/reconcile publication, rebuild bounded view/correct storage; IF-REC-012/013

frames.title: Runtime authority revoked/replay inspection
frames.annotation: Old callbacks unavailable to publish; replay-origin context omits later price data. Fresh valid session/catch-up or return; explicit exit before latest-price inspection; IF-REC-012

frames.title: Valid confirmation review
frames.annotation: Exact consequence/scope/version co-present with confirm/cancel. Old state authoritative; cancel unchanged; IF-REC-006/014

frames.title: No valid target/missing evidence/failed validation
frames.annotation: Confirm unavailable with specific reason; scoped return/cancel visible. Nothing activated; choose valid target/evidence; IF-REC-006/014

frames.title: Target/version changed
frames.annotation: Prior approval proposal explicitly invalid; revised consequence requires review. No old confirmation reused; IF-REC-006/014

frames.title: Confirmed preparation/reconstruction
frames.annotation: Phase visible, no premature replacement success; old coherent state remains authoritative. Cancellation supported only before irreversible publication; after publication reconcile; IF-REC-006/014

frames.title: Cancelled/known failed prepublication
frames.annotation: Clear unchanged original target/cursor result. Return to invoker, no destructive retry; IF-REC-006/014

frames.title: Replacement outcome unknown
frames.annotation: Persistent reconciliation condition; no repeated replacement or guessed rollback. Resolve whole old/new generation first; IF-REC-006/013/014

frames.title: Known successful replacement
frames.annotation: Surviving new state/mode, fresh epoch and actual publication result identified. Return to meaningful survivor; no promise of automatic discarded-state archive; IF-REC-006/014

frames.title: Offline/restricted authority
frames.annotation: Local valid operations need no provider network; unavailable required input or denied writer/epoch explained. Existing work unchanged; fresh valid intent/authority needed; IF-REC-013/014

frames.title: Ready/source selected
frames.annotation: Output kind/source/scope and required labels visible. Explicit generate separate from inspection; IF-REC-011

frames.title: Missing values/empty results/not renderable
frames.annotation: Scope-specific absence reason; no fabricated report values or image preview. Return/select meaningful source or valid subset preserving absence labels; IF-REC-011

frames.title: Preparing/writing
frames.annotation: Pinned source and actual phase visible, workspace changes do not relabel output. Await/cancel supported preparation; source unchanged; IF-REC-011

frames.title: Source advanced/superseded after pin
frames.annotation: Original source version/cursor remains identified; optional new preparation explicit. Finish same snapshot or start new intent; no silent latest switch; IF-REC-011

frames.title: Known failed/incomplete artifact
frames.annotation: Explain local output failure and incomplete state. Verify or retry same pinned snapshot/correct storage; IF-REC-011

frames.title: Artifact outcome unknown
frames.annotation: Verification responsibility persists; no false success/repeat. Verify complete matching artifact first; IF-REC-011

frames.title: Verified complete
frames.annotation: Matching local artifact outcome and source labels visible. Return to invoking selection; no source-state mutation; IF-REC-011

frames.title: Offline/restricted disclosure/invalid source scope
frames.annotation: Local export may continue with valid local source; forbidden/missing data or stale scope explained. Preserve source, correct source/authority, no secret leakage/hosted fallback; IF-REC-011/013
